description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
